candidates.reason: Primary coverage for the change: it exercises scrapy.utils._compression and the HTTP compression downloader middleware end to end. It currently calls _skip_if_no_zstd() (pytest.importorskip("zstandard")) in every zstd test, asserts the Accept-Encoding header equals ACCEPTED_ENCODINGS, and contains test_process_response_zstd_unsupported, which asserts the missing-zstandard warning that becomes unreachable once compression.zstd/backports.zstd is always available. These are exactly the assertions that must change with this PR.

Secondary: this is the only test module that inspects the dependency wiring for the pinned/minimum test environments, reading tox.ini through ConfigParser. The PR rewires the zstd dependency (removing zstandard entries from tox.ini extra-deps/min-extra-deps/vcs-deps and adding backports.zstd>=1.3.0; python_version < "3.14" to pyproject.toml), so the tox/pyproject dependency lists this module validates are edited by the change.
